answer: Bind identity to hardware attestation. At registration, an agent presents a manufacturer-signed enclave quote, and the registry stores a hash of the processor serial; a second key from that silicon is refused. Every fake therefore needs its own physical processor, about three hundred dollars of rented enclave capacity. A leaked unit gets revoked, so no haven for clones exists, and one breach cannot ripple past it. Even a falcon-fast farm pays linearly.
